project.name: BOOK DESK / 简易图书管理系统
project.purpose: Single numeric source of truth for production WinForms/AntdUI geometry, spacing, responsive behavior, table sizing and screenshot-diff acceptance.

priority: ui-spec.json for every numeric geometry, spacing, responsive and component-size decision
approved prototype PNGs for visual appearance / hierarchy / color verification
current application code for business logic, data and behavior
sourceOfTruth.hardRule: If a dimension or responsive behavior is defined in ui-spec.json, implementation MUST NOT re-estimate it from a screenshot. Prototype PNGs are visual references only.

rules: Use AutoScaleMode.Dpi, not AutoScaleMode.Font, on shell/forms participating in the responsive system.
Do not apply a custom global scale factor based on resolution.
Do not multiply all coordinates, fonts, padding, control heights or column widths by screenWidth/referenceWidth.
DPI scaling handles physical pixel density; responsive profiles handle available logical client area.
Use Dock, Anchor, TableLayoutPanel and FlowLayoutPanel for responsive structure; avoid page-wide absolute coordinates.
Test at 100%, 125% and 150% Windows scaling for clipping; geometry screenshot diff baseline is captured at 100% / 96 DPI.
win7Notes: Do not require PerMonitorV2 APIs for correctness.
Changing monitor DPI while the process is running is not an acceptance requirement on Windows 7.
All primary controls must remain readable and unclipped at common system DPI settings.

zeroToleranceFailures: workspace-level horizontal scrollbar at supported sizes
search input and adjacent action button not equal height / baseline
bottom primary purchase action not visible
purchase header labels or controls clipped vertically
purchase top toolbar button text clipped or rendered without usable padding

viewports.captureDimensionMeaning: Target application window outer size for manual screenshots. Automated pixel diff MUST crop to the application client content region so native OS window chrome does not create false diffs.

minimumSupportedClient.policy: Primary actions and key data may not clip. Whole-workspace horizontal scrolling is forbidden; table-local horizontal scrolling is last resort only below the mandatory 1366x768 test size.

typography.rendering: Prefer GDI/TextRenderer-compatible metrics for WinForms; do not mix font families on the same page.

control.sameHeightRule: All inputs/selects/date controls and adjacent action buttons in one row use the profile controlHeight.

shadow.note: Use border hierarchy instead of large web-style shadows. A very subtle 1px ambient shadow is allowed only where AntdUI already provides it.

windowTitleBar.appName: 简易图书管理系统  BOOK DESK

sidebar.selectedBehavior: Selected row background uses selectedNavBackground and a 3px primary left indicator.

pageHeader.note: Do not render the per-page top-right text/status '本机离线'. Sidebar bottom offline state may remain.

rules: Reduce margins/padding/gaps before reducing font size.
Never reduce normal control height below 32 logical px.
Primary actions never move below the viewport.
Toolbar may wrap only at explicitly declared wrap points.
Table columns shrink to minWidth by shrinkPriority before any table-local horizontal scroll.
Do not hide business-critical columns unless the page explicitly defines a hide priority.
Do not enlarge controls, fonts, sidebar or table row heights merely because more pixels are available.
Give extra width to flexible search/table/detail regions.
Use additional width to reduce truncation and expose more table content, not to create oversized whitespace.

items.name: search
items.placeholder: 输入店内编码、ISBN、书名、作者或出版社

columnSizingAlgorithm: Identification priority is ISBN / title / author / publisher / category / price / stock.
At constrained widths, hide low-priority metadata before hiding publisher/category.
Hide priority: enabled, binding, publicationYear, shelf, storeCode, then other secondary metadata.
Empty textual cells render an em dash (—) without writing the dash back to SQLite.
At standard/expanded widths, restore columns as space permits and keep title flexible.

compact: Toolbar may use two rows only if the first row cannot keep the search input >= 360px.
Search input, 查询, 新增图书 and 编辑资料 always use the same profile controlHeight.
ISBN / 书名 / 作者 / 出版社 / 分类 / 销售价格 / 库存 are the highest-priority visible fields.
店内编码 / 出版年 / 装帧 / 货架位 / 启用状态 hide first on constrained Win7 screens.
Text fields with no information display —.
standard: Keep all search/actions on one row.
Search input flexes first; buttons keep specified preferred widths.
All 12 table columns remain visible without workspace horizontal scrolling.
expanded: Grow title/author/publisher/category/shelf columns according to flex; do not enlarge fixed numeric/status columns.

topToolbar.heightRule: Top toolbar buttons use 42px standard/expanded and 40px compact, with explicit horizontal padding; text clipping is a zero-tolerance failure.

columnSizingAlgorithm: Give surplus to title first, then author/publisher.
Shrink title/author/storeCode/ISBN/publisher according to shrinkPriority down to minWidth.

No workspace horizontal scrollbar at mandatory viewports.

detailPanel.heightPolicy: With the scan/search card removed, the detail table receives the reclaimed vertical space. Document header, note row and sticky summary bar retain their fixed profile heights.

noteRow.placeholder: 可选：填写到货批次、物流或其他备注

metricsGroup.compactBehavior: Shrink chip widths and horizontal padding; if still constrained, render metrics as compact inline label/value pairs. Metrics may never force the action group off-screen.

visibilityContract: summaryBar is outside the scrollable detail/table region and Dock=Bottom.
actionGroup is right-pinned and never wraps.
复核入库 must be fully visible at 1366x768 without vertical or horizontal scrolling.
When width is constrained, shrink metrics first, then metric gaps/padding; never shrink or hide the primary action.
When height is constrained, detail table loses height first; summaryBar height remains fixed for the profile.

acceptedInput: manual identifier typing while table owns focus
tableScanner.exactMatchBehavior: Immediately add one unit to the purchase detail. If the same book already exists, increment its quantity by 1.
tableScanner.noExactMatchBehavior: Open advancedBookLookupDialog and prefill ISBN for ISBN-shaped identifiers, otherwise prefill 店内编码.
editingSafety: Do not capture scanner characters while Quantity or UnitCostYuan cell editor is active.
After cell editing completes, restore scanner capture to the table.
Reviewed documents never capture scanner input.

advancedBookLookupDialog.title: 选择图书（高级查找）
advancedBookLookupDialog.searchLogic: All non-empty filters combine with AND. Text filters use contains matching; category uses exact matching. Only active book records are returned.
behaviors: Double-clicking a result confirms it and closes the dialog.
添加到单据 adds the selected book to purchase detail without closing, allowing batch lookup.
确定 adds the selected result once and closes.
新增资料 opens the existing book editor; after save, the new book is selected in the lookup results.

compact: Top toolbar may wrap after 导出 Excel; 清空明细 may move to row 2, but scan row and document row retain their control heights.
Document card may split into two rows: row 1 = 采购日期 + 采购单号; row 2 = 供应商 + 草稿状态.
Summary bar stays docked to bottom; actionGroup never wraps and always shows 复核入库.
Reduce metric chip widths/padding before reducing table width or action buttons.
Table columns shrink to minWidth according to shrinkPriority; no business-critical column is hidden at 1366x768.
The removed scan card must not leave blank vertical space. Reclaimed height belongs to the detail table.
standard: Document card remains one row at 1600x900 and 1920x1080.
Summary metrics and actionGroup remain one row.
Advanced lookup dialog keeps all six filters usable; on narrower dialog widths filters may compress but may not clip text.
expanded: Grow supplier/search/title/author/publisher regions with available width.
Keep bottom summary/action group compact and right anchored.
Advanced lookup fields do not grow into oversized controls; surplus width goes to book title/results table.

At main-content width < 1020px switch to vertical stack: inventory table first, detail pane below.

items.label: 关键词
items.placeholder: 单号、ISBN、书名、备注或供应商

compact: 类型 / 从 / 到保持第一行，关键词与查询保持第二行。
关键词宽度使用 compact 360px 上限并允许缩到 220px；不再通过挤压同一行导致占位文字或输入框裁切。
查询按钮始终保持完整可见并与关键词输入框同一视觉高度。
Helper text becomes a single-line ellipsis or hides if vertical space is constrained.
Bill list and bill detail both remain visible; allocate vertical space approximately 58% / 42% after filters.

pricingRules: 单品折扣先于整单折扣计算。
折扣百分比转 basis points 保存：100.00%=10000。
每一步都在分级金额上按 MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero 舍入到整数分。
sales_order_items.unit_price_cent 保存两级折扣后的实际成交单价，确保部分退货按真实支付金额退款。
历史销售单保持折扣前价格、单品折扣、整单折扣和最终成交价快照。

compact: 折扣列保持可见，优先隐藏店内编码、作者、ISBN等辅助识别列。
底部整单折扣输入框和确认结账按钮始终完整可见。

dictionaryManagement.purpose: 统一管理结构化供应商与可扩展的简单字典。

providers.label: 图书分类
behavior: 新增/编辑值立即可用于图书资料分类选择。
停用不清空历史图书分类。
重命名图书分类时在同一事务中同步现有 books.category。
Overlay covers the application client area, not the non-client title bar.
Render a snapshot of the real current page beneath a roughly 42% dim layer.
Redraw the target rectangle at full brightness and outline it with the application accent.
Do not use whole-form opacity to dim the UI because that also dims the guide card and makes the target unreadable.

winFormsLayout: Use TableLayoutPanel for deterministic toolbar/form geometry.
Use FlowLayoutPanel only where the spec explicitly permits wrapping.
Fixed logical sizes are allowed for stable controls defined by this spec.
Apply MinimumSize / MaximumSize to columns and key controls according to this spec.
Application icon is generated reproducibly before compilation and embedded in the EXE; installer, shortcuts and WinForms title bars use the same BOOK DESK icon.
resizingPriority: Compress flexible table columns to minWidth by shrinkPriority
Wrap only at explicitly declared wrap points
Hide optional helper text only where explicitly allowed
Use table-local scrolling only below mandatory test sizes
forbidden: Global ScaleTransform / custom scale factor based on screen resolution
Large shadows, glassmorphism, complex gradients or 3D effects
Page title larger than 20 logical px in standard/expanded profiles
Input/select/date control height different from adjacent action button height
Re-estimating any defined dimension from a prototype PNG
Workspace-level horizontal scrollbar at 1366x768 or larger

visualValidation.referenceOwnership: Approved prototype PNG per page and viewport

capture.automatedDiffCrop: application client content region; exclude native OS frame/chrome
capture.dataFixture: deterministic seeded fixture; identical records/order/content for reference and implementation
capture.cursorAndFocus: hide mouse cursor; focus state must match reference

process: Build Release or deterministic UI-test build.
Launch with the fixed screenshot fixture/database.
Wait until layout, fonts and AntdUI animations are settled.
Crop to the defined client content region for automated comparison.
Create 50% opacity overlay and absolute RGB diff image.
Measure changed-pixel ratio using the configured RGB tolerance.
Fail immediately on any zero-tolerance condition.
Repeat for all four required viewports.
